name: estimate-price
title_zh: 按品相折价后，Discogs 市价才落进你的库存表
tagline_zh: 别拿全新价当二手价。它读你表里每张唱片的「Состояние」品相，把 Discogs 成交统计折成对应档位。
tagline_en: Don't price a VG+ copy like a Mint one. Reads each record's condition grade, discounts Discogs stats to match.
desc_en: Fold Discogs marketplace listing stats (already fetched by enrich-details) into data/prices.json, condition-adjusted using each record's "Состояние" grade from the sheet. Requires enrich-details to have already run (needs each record's Discogs release id).
why_zh: 不是简单抄均价——它把市场分布按品相档位切分，再对齐你表里的俄语品相字段，折价逻辑有据可依。
why_en: It doesn't just copy the median—it slices the market distribution by condition grade, maps your sheet's Russian condition labels.
limit_zh: 只认 enrich-details 跑过、且表里有 Discogs release id 的记录。
limit_en: Requires enrich-details output with Discogs release IDs; condition must be in the 'Состояние' column. Writes only data/prices.json—doesn't touch the.
title_en: Fold Discogs prices into your sheet, adjusted by condition
